faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.trackOrderBanner: You can track your orders in 'My Orders'.
faq.emptyFaq: No FAQs available for this category yet.

top-queries.q: What is Try and Buy Service?
top-queries.a: Try and Buy is a service that allows you to try on your purchases at home and pay for only what you like.

top-queries.q: Why are there different prices for the same product? Is it legal?
top-queries.a: Different sellers may offer the same product at different prices based on their pricing strategy.

top-queries.q: I saw the product at Rs. 1000 but post clicking on the product, there are multiple prices...
top-queries.a: Prices can vary based on size, color, or seller availability.

top-queries.q: How will I detect fraudulent emails/calls seeking sensitive information?
top-queries.a: We will never ask for your passwords, PINs, or OTPs. Please do not share these details.

top-queries.q: How do I cancel the order, I have placed?
top-queries.a: You can cancel your order from the 'My Orders' section before it gets dispatched.

shipping.a: Usually it takes 1-2 days inside the city and 3-5 working days outside.
Delivery charge varies depending on your location and order value.

shipping.q: How can I track my order?
shipping.a: You can track your order status in the 'My Orders' section.

returns.q: Can I return a product if there is an issue?
returns.a: Yes, you can initiate a return within 7 days of delivery.

returns.q: How do I create a Return Request?
returns.a: Go to 'My Orders', select the item, and click 'Return/Exchange'.

payments.a: We accept Cash on Delivery, bKash, Nagad, and all major cards.
